semiconductor_relevance: High — Casting Machining Engineering Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing precision stainless steel components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Casting Machining Engineering Co., Ltd. (CME) manufactures high-quality stainless steel components, including vacuum fittings, flanges, and valves, specifically designed for the semiconductor and vacuum industries. With certifications in ISO9001, ISO14000, and ISO45000, CME ensures its products meet rigorous standards for precision and cleanliness required in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Manufacturing of vacuum fittings and flanges
Production of precision valves for semiconductor applications
Machining and polishing of stainless steel components
Development of vacuum and flow control components
technical_expertise: Material science for stainless steel components

regional_presence.Taiwan: CME was founded in Taiwan and has established a strong manufacturing presence there.
regional_presence.China: In 2003, CME expanded operations by establishing a factory in Changsha, China, enhancing its machining and polishing capabilities.
